screen.dimblend_experience.nickname.no_t: Hold an item, or look at a block
screen.dimblend_experience.nickname.no_i: That block has no item form
screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.shake_: Default: 2.0 seconds. Range: 0.1-60.0, step: 0.1. 0 disables random draws.
screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.soilin: Default: 0.5. Range: 0.00-1.00, step: 0.01. Chance = min(1, speed / 12 x multiplier). 0 disables dirtiness draws.
screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.couple: Default: off. Allows redstone signals to unlock automatic couplers.
Default: off. Allows Survival players to interact with automatic couplers.
screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.limite: Default: on. Checks new source water in the rotating dimension. The ice placement rule has its own setting.
screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.portab: Default: on. Allows only one Portable Engine per connected kinetic network, including stopped networks.
screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.steam_: Default: on. Sustained overload breaks the shaft. Disabling clears active warnings and exhaust effects.
screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.diesel: Default: on. Applies to Small, Modular and Large engines. Disabling cancels pending destruction and clears overload latches.
screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.motor_: Default: on. Overload locks the output and doubles energy use. Disabling clears the overload latch.
screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.radio_: Default: 0.50 (the former on level). Range: 0.00-1.00, step: 0.01. Scales the static, crackle and voices: 0 plays every radio clean, 1.00 is twice the former level. Overworld and underground play clean; the Nether and modded areas add faint static; the End lets faint enderman voices through now and then; Voidscape plays static only.
Default: 1.00. Range: 0.00-2.00, step: 0.01. Scales the simulated echo (reflections and reverb). 0 leaves only the direct sound, which keeps its occlusion and 3D direction.
screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.exp_cl: Default: 1.00 (clears all). Range: 0.00-1.00, step: 0.01. Rotating dimension only: respawn experience = pre-death x (1 - ratio), ignoring the keepInventory game rule; experience orbs never drop.

screen.dimblend_experience.tuning.no_per: Permission level 2 is required to change parameters.
